subject: [PATCH v5 04/11] mm, swap: support physical swap as a vswap backend

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch adds support for physical swap as a backend for the virtual swap layer, allowing zswap to allocate physical slots on demand when it declines a page. It introduces a new mechanism to track physical slots via pointer-tagged swap_table entries and modifies readahead and swapoff operations to work with this new system. The patch also includes changes to handle cases where zswap is disabled or the folio's cgroup does not support vswap, bypassing vswap and mapping the slot directly into PTEs.
